description: Agent Skill CLI for SEO, GEO, AEO, accessibility, performance, and deployment-readiness audits
notes: Package managers install only launcher files and package metadata; they must not create, update, back up, or remove user or project skill directories.
Run 'gas-optimizer install' to copy the skill into a host location.
After upgrading the package, run 'gas-optimizer sync' to update recorded installations.
Installation state is recorded at $GAS_OPTIMIZER_HOME/installations.json with schemaVersion 1 and installedVersion.
